newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - OCT 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - OCT 31.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on October 31. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364.
Indonesia's unemployment rate increased by 0.8 percent between 1994 and 1995, Manpower Minister Abdul Latief said. In 1995, the unemployed accounted for 5.2 percent of the population.
A British company is to build a US$900 million container port on Batam Island, 20 km south of Singapore. Indoport will begin the first phase of construction early next year.

The government agreed not to interfere in the affairs of the Indonesia National Youth Committee which had earlier complained that the organisation was becoming a vehicle for Indonesia's ruling political party Golkar.

Indonesia's national airline Garuda on Wednesday launched its maiden flight to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, via Batam Island near Singapore. The president diirector of Garuda, Supandi, said Batam would become the gateway for flights to the Middle East.

Indonesian timber tycoon "Bob" Hasan said the group of which he is commissioner will not restructure the management of the country's largest automobile manufacturer PT Astra Internasional. The Nusamba group has recently bought around a 10 percent stake in Astra.
Indonesia will continue to keep the rupiah against the dollar at a reasonable rate in a bid to maintain monetary stability, Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said.
